programs.title: The Big Dig/Catalog Slog
programs.desc: The Rangers discover that Preston Praxton has been causing earthquakes by digging underground  Preston sends out big, thick catalogs that overflow landfills.

programs.title: Preston Fest/Snakes on a Plain
programs.desc: Preston throws a music festival that destroys all the local vegetation, threatening local wildlife who are now going hungry  the Rangers help protect the lives of snakes during their migration.

programs.title: HideandSeek
programs.desc: The Cubbies, bored with their usual games, decide to play Hide and Seek- a game unfamiliar to them. Lacking knowledge of the rules, they seek help from Cuddle Power to learn how to play. Through a magical huddle, the Cubbies discover the excitement of Hide and Seek, bringing a new element of fun to their playtime.

programs.title: Fashion Genes
programs.desc: In order to have the best girl modeling her designs, Nicky decides to clone herself.

programs.title: Drone Attack
programs.desc: Jerry's mischievous behavior leads to a mess of toys and books scattered around the living room. Jane tries to catch the thrown objects but ends up getting hit herself. However, Jerry realizes Jane's sadness and starts helping her collect the items. They work together, with Jerry attempting to balance a pile of books and Jane using a box to collect the toys. After some mishaps, they successfully gather everyt_hing, but when the box breaks, they find themselves buried under the pile. They laugh together, realizing the joy in their shared experience.

programs.title: CHRISTMAS_PART 2
programs.desc: Unknown to the world, Thomas Edison built a secret lab where he invented a virtual version of himself and a robot named Von Bolt. With Edison as their guide, Angie and friends JD, Kent and Nicky set out to explore the fascinating world of science
